name: The New Plague

angles.text: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks toxins that can harm the living and the dead. It pursues Forsaken supremacy and protection for its young nation.
The Horde accepts the Forsaken as allies in the Eastern Kingdoms, yet the Apothecarium’s grim experiments often trouble its more honorable members.

faq.answer: Theodore Griffs is a researcher with the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity’s Apothecarium. He studies potent toxins and strange specimens to make compounds for the Forsaken, and has little patience for those who fail to value careful alchemical work.
Witherfang is a venomous arthropod found in the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity. Its toxin can dissolve even resilient undead flesh.

aliases: what does theodore want with witherfang
why collect the highly toxic strain
faq.answer: Theodore Griffs wants to learn how Witherfang’s venom eats through undead flesh. He hopes to recreate its effects for the Forsaken’s alchemical arsenal.
faq.q: Why does Theodore Griffs want Witherfang's venom?

faq.answer: Theodore Griffs hoped you would keep Witherfang intact or gather its venom carefully. He is annoyed that it was slain, but recovered enough ichor from its remains to study.
faq.q: Why is Theodore Griffs upset when you return?

faq.answer: The Apothecarium is the Royal Apothecary Society’s research center beneath Lordaeron. There, its members test dangerous strains, make alchemical weapons, and experiment on strange creatures. It is the Undercity’s most vital quarter.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Apothecarium?

faq.answer: Theodore Griffs believes the surest way to spread a potent strain is to put it directly into the bloodstream.
faq.q: How does Theodore believe virulent strains are best transmitted?

sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society gathers dangerous substances from across Azeroth. Theodore Griffs is one of its researchers. He tracks strange beasts and deadly contaminants to advance Forsaken alchemy. Now rumors tell of a venomous creature in the shattered stone above, so Griffs sends you to bring back a sample before the chance is lost.
sections.title: The Apothecary's Ambition

sections.body: Witherfang is the venomous arthropod stalking the surface ruins of Lordaeron. Its venom breaks down living tissue and dead, preserved flesh alike. Griffs wants to learn how it overcomes the resistance of dead flesh, knowledge that could help refine biological weapons and protect the Forsaken kingdom.
sections.title: A Flesh-Dissolving Toxin

sections.body: Theodore Griffs is frustrated that Witherfang was killed instead of captured alive. Still, the gathered ichor gives him enough to study. By breaking down the creature’s bodily fluids, he hopes to learn how its venom works and add to the Undercity’s growing chemical knowledge.
sections.title: Reverse Engineering the Ichor

summary: In the Undercity, Theodore Griffs studies reports of a lethal creature in the ruins above. Its venom consumes even undead flesh, and he seeks to learn how its toxins work.
attribution: In-game quest text: The New Plague
